Later spreadsheet normalization preserved the corrected expression.
additional_context: Age is active in source/fhir.ini and the current source/datatypes/age.xml Age invariant row contains the exact requested FHIRPath expression. Earlier related FHIR-12591 established the value > 0 part of the same invariant. Later release history files also carry the corrected code.exists() expression, and community searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The requested correction is already present in the current build source, so the published commit is an empty audit commit.
